summary: Revised UX implementation plan specifically optimized for iPhone 13 / mobile touch screen. Demotes desktop keyboard shortcuts to secondary passive listeners (no intrusive UI). Prioritizes one-handed mobile ergonomics: thumb-zone bottom navigation and action bar, iOS safe-area padding (pb-safe), 44px touch targets, Reader mode ergonomics (reading time, margins, font sizing), smooth edge-swipe gestures, and haptic feedback.
